# God's Timeless Rhythms
## Scripture
"For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven..." - Ecclesiastes 3:1

## Reflection
As we gaze up at the night sky, we're reminded of the celestial rhythms that govern our universe. The phases of the moon, the rotation of the planets, and the changing of the seasons all operate on a divine schedule. Just as the Earth rotates on its axis to bring us day and night, so too does our lives have its own rhythms and seasons. There are times of growth, times of harvest, and times of rest. In the midst of life's ebbs and flows, it's comforting to know that God is the master conductor, orchestrating every moment to bring about His perfect plan.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, thank you for the reminder that our lives are part of a larger cosmic rhythm. Help us to trust in Your sovereignty and timing, even when we don't understand the seasons we're in. Give us the wisdom to discern the rhythms of our lives and to flow with Your divine schedule. May we find peace and purpose in the midst of change, knowing that You are always working everything out for our good. Amen.
